{{Top|leg}}
'''Scimitar Leader''' was a title and callsign given to the commander of the [[Scimitar Squadron (New Republic)|Scimitar Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]].<ref name="DW">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

During the [[Battle of Bilbringi (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Bilbringi]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], [[Ijix Harona]] was the holder of the title.<ref name="FP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>
